tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Search Israeli public tenders in Tendy's catalog by free text and filters. Tender data is Hebrew; `query` matches best in Hebrew, in the user's own words. By default only open procurement tenders are returned (published, submission deadline still ahead), the same default as the Tendy website search;

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: Get one tender from Tendy: what is being bought, deadlines, eligibility thresholds (תנאי סף), requirements, budget and fees, set-asides, supplier size fit, a next-steps brief, and its documents. `tender` is the tender page URL from a search_tenders or list_my_feed result, or its slug. tools.name: list_my_feed
tools.description: List tenders that pass the user's Tendy profile filters: its categories (a parent category includes its subcategories), regions and budget range. tools.name: search_tender_documents
tools.description: Search the documents (PDFs) of one procurement tender and return up to 5 relevant passages, each with its document name and pages. Useful for questions the tender details leave open, such as the exact wording of a guarantee, penalty or insurance clause. `question` matches best in Hebrew, in the user

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List Tendy's tender categories: 13 parent categories with their subcategories, as slug and Hebrew name. Pass a slug or Hebrew name as the `category` input of search_tenders. Categories describe what is being bought, not who is buying. browse_collection opens a category's public page by the same slug

tools.name: browse_collection
tools.description: One public Tendy hub page in a single answer: the tenders of a category, of a publishing body, of an Israeli region, or all government or all municipal tenders. Returns the page's direct answer, counts as of today (shown, with a known future deadline, and the whole catalog including closed tenders),

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List the Tendy hub pages that browse_collection opens, each with the kind and key to pass, its link and current counts. tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get the signed-in user's Tendy profile filters: the categories, regions and budget range that list_my_feed filters on. Read-only. profiles is empty when the account has no profile.

tools.name: update_my_profile
tools.description: Changes the signed-in user's Tendy profile filters: the categories, regions and budget range that list_my_feed, the daily digest and the alerts filter on. The change is saved.
